connections.note: Michael Shellenberger reported the Immaculate Constellation allegations on Public and then entered the twelve-page report into the record as a witness before the House Committee on Oversight and Accountability on 13 November 2024. The chain runs leak to Substack to sworn testimony with no traditional newsroom in it, which is the domain's thesis stated as a single case.

connections.note: Shellenberger brought the Immaculate Constellation allegation to Congress, arguing 'there is a growing body of evidence that the U.S. Government is not being transparent about what it knows about unidentified anomalous phenomena and that elements within the military and the IC are in violation of their constitutional duty to notify Congress of their operations.' The name appears seventeen times across the printed hearing.

connections.note: The hearing's own index of documents records the route the material took into the record: 'Report, Pentagon, ``Immaculate Constellation``; submitted by Rep. Mace.' Mace chaired the sitting - Shellenberger's statement opens by addressing her as Chairwoman - and it was she, not the witness, who entered the document.

desc: Public is the Substack newsletter co-founded by Michael Shellenberger covering censorship, cities, mental health, addiction, energy and the environment. Its relevance here is narrow and sharp: it is the outlet through which Shellenberger reported the Immaculate Constellation allegations before entering the twelve-page report into the congressional record on 13 November 2024. Public is a further instance of the pattern that defines this domain - the most consequential UAP reporting of the period was published on subscription platforms owned by individual journalists rather than by newsrooms.
